description: Source code for a Zephyr sensor driver implementing hinge angle sensing functionality, including initialization, attribute setting, data event handling, and hinge angle calculation.

methods.name: hinge_init
methods.description: Initializes the hinge angle sensor device, retrieves reporters, and logs their info.

methods.name: hinge_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as sampling frequency.

methods.name: hinge_submit
methods.description: Submits a sensor I/O operation request.

methods.name: calc_hinge_angle
methods.description: Calculates the hinge angle based on accelerometer samples.

methods.name: hinge_reporter_on_data_event
methods.description: Handles data events from reporters, processes samples, and computes hinge angle.
